overview: NebuLink Gateway NLG8400 is a SCADA RTU unit for remote logic control and monitoring in various industrial applications. It is powered by an ARM Cortex-A7 processor with multiple interfaces: RS232, RS485, cellular, analog and digital I/Os.

It offers easy, user-friendly development support that allows users to implement control logic on the controller using the pre-programmed QuecOpen OS. The QuecOpen SDK includes validated Modbus RTU, Modbus TCP and DLMS stacks.

The NLG8400 is designed specifically for low-cost, battery-enabled M2M applications, providing a long, stable life cycle and easy deployment. A built-in lightweight web server supports remote monitoring and the unit integrates seamlessly with SCADA applications; it is covered by a two-year warranty.
